body: in [News](https://www.kiplinger.com/news). * [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.kiplinger.com%2Finvesting%2Fstocks%2F17494%2Fnext-week-earnings-calendar-stocks). * [X](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?text=Earnings+Calendar+and+Analysis+for+This+Week+%28June+1-5%29&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.kiplinger.com%2Finvesting%2Fstocks%2F17494%2Fnext-week-earnings-calendar-stocks). [Sign up](https://www.kiplinger.com/newsletter). **Dollar General** ([DG](https://www.kiplinger.com/tfn/ticker.html?ticker=DG)) beat Wall Street expectations for its fiscal first-quarter bottom line and raised its full-year guidance, but the [consumer staples stock](https://www.kiplinger.com/investing/stocks/best-consumer-staples-stocks-to-buy) missed the consensus estimate for the top line. [Dollar General](https://investor.dollargeneral.com/news-detail/dollar-general-corporation-reports-first-quarter-2026-results/e158b4ec-348e-427a-b718-68c0f69ac2e4) reported earnings of $2 per share on sales of $10.79 billion vs a forecast of $1.88 on $10.81 billion. "While the market's sentiment on the [dollar stores](https://www.kiplinger.com/personal-finance/how-to-save-money/602810/best-things-to-buy-at-dollar-stores-dollar-tree) is cautious, this pessimism has created an opportunity with DG shares.".
